{{Top|leg}}
A '''trash punch''' was a tool utilized by [[Janitor/Legends|sanitation workers]]. The device was used to spear trash and garbage to clean up [[City/Legends|city]] streets. The trash punch could also be used as a makeshift [[Melee weapon/Legends|melee weapon]] if needed. [[Birrge]], a sanitation worker in [[Hanna City/Legends|Hanna City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]], used a trash punch on a [[Standard day/Legends|daily]] basis.<ref name="PSG">''[[Platt's Smugglers Guide]]''</ref>
